entries.title: Prospective independent replication of source 48x48 fermion sharp-constant candidate

stages.observation: Previously explored 48x48 original-source coefficient matrix exhibits smaller candidate norm constant than conservative 8 sqrt(3), but not formally established for the physical unnormalized field.
stages.question: Does the source coefficient matrix-derived CAR norm obey 16 sqrt(2/3)||X|| for all X, and what finite tests can refute the candidate?
background: Historical A/B and source-premise Python audits
stages.hypothesis: forall nonzero source X in R^(3x9), ||B_K(X)||/||X|| <= 16 sqrt(2/3); reduced spectral and polynomial identities hold
falsifiers: exact source K0 polynomial residual nonzero on an integer X
direct SVD candidate norm ratio exceeds bound beyond verified numerical tolerance
reduced spectral formula fails a direct calculation reproducibly after source/precision checks

controls: pinned source gamma and epsilon blobs
experiment.independent_followup: separate high precision or exact symbolic implementation with source pins and independently recomputed coefficients

stages.analysis_plan: Retain all samples and maximal discrepancies; investigate every violation using exact/high precision and verify pin/normalization before classifying.
stages.conclusion_rule: FALSIFIED for reproducible verified counterexample; INCONCLUSIVE for failure/drift/uncontrolled numerical instability; SURVIVED_FINITE_TESTS if all controls pass, never mathematical proof.
stages.communication: Record exact commit, script SHA, environment, raw output hash, independent reproduction and a plain-language verdict in the experiment registry and linked research note.
